The 2011 German Grand Prix, held at the Nürburgring on 24 July 2011 (round 10), was won by Lewis Hamilton of McLaren. He started from 2nd on the grid. Fernando Alonso (Ferrari) finished second and Mark Webber (Red Bull) third.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
